a=DEAD; p=$(cat /data/local/tmp/.bixby_hijack.pid 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$p" ] && grep -qa hijack_daemon /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then a=ALIVE; else for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do grep -qa hijack_daemon $d/cmdline 2>/dev/null && { a=ALIVE; break; }; done; fi; echo $a; M=/data/adb/modules/bixbykey_hijack; if [ -d $M ]; then echo MOD; else echo NOMOD; fi; head -n 6 $M/hijack_daemon.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'daemon - v' ; echo END
